events.text: Read-only query on the production settings table (key presence and lengths only, no secret values).

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read Zoom seat state keys from production D1
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; npx wrangler d1 execute revops-centre --remote --json --command "SELECT key, length(value) AS len, CASE WHEN key IN ('zoom_seat','zoom_cohosts','zoom_seat_email') THEN substr(value,1,200) WHEN key='zoom_runsheet' THEN substr(value,1,60) ELSE '' END AS v FROM settings WHERE key IN ('zoom_sdk_enc','zoom_seat','zoom_runsheet','zoom_cohosts','zoom_seat_email','zoom_s2s_enc')" 2>&1 | python3 -c "import sys,json;s=sys.stdin.read();i=s.find('[');d=json.loads(s[i:]);[print(r) for r in d[0]['results']]"
